author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I am prepared to accept that the risk assessment remains a manual step for now. I will not object to your team handling that review by hand, provided it does not slow down the broader rollout. However, the data contracts themselves must be fully automated and governed. I need the consent checks enforced by tooling before any loyalty basket data enters the pipeline. I am willing to give up the speed of immediate contract deployment to ensure this layer is airtight. If the contracts are not automated, I will refuse to sign off on the integration. I accept the delay in contract work to guarantee that no personal data bypasses the governance controls. This is the only trade I am making.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the speed of immediate contract deployment to ensure the governance layer is airtight, defining a specific sacrifice for a desired outcome.
